rule_cited: Severity 1 includes a pure feature request
Severity 4 = clearly blocked core task (cannot play music)
Ad interruptions are usability; annoyance is severity 2
Access is login/signup/account; limited functionality = vague paywall -> billing, severity 2 (decision 1b)
Decision 1b: vague paywall with no named feature -> billing, severity 2
Positive about few ads: praise; first specific praised feature (ads) -> usability; severity 1
Severity 1 (no reported problem) contradicts a complaint label; review praises support for fixing the app
